.. _SPLIT:

SPLIT
=====

Extracts a single channel from a stereo PCM buffer.

Arguments
---------

+-----------+------------+------------------------------------------------------+
| Name      | Type       | Description                                          |
+===========+============+======================================================+
| channel   | ``int``    | Channel to extract.                                  |
+-----------+------------+------------------------------------------------------+

Input
-----

+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                                 |
+==========+==========+==================================================+
| ``s32v`` | PCM buffer. Stereo only.                                    |
+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+

Output
------

+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                                 |
+==========+==========+==================================================+
| ``s32v`` | Extracted single-channel PCM buffer.                        |
+----------+-------------------------------------------------------------+

Example
-------

.. code-block:: bash

   SPLIT 0
